newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices mixed in quiet activity.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices mixed in quiet activity.

text.p: Cash millfeed prices were mixed on Thursday amid featureless activity, several millfeed dealers said.
"There has been a slowdown in feed business," one dealer said, referring to an easing of demand in parts of Texas.
In the northeast, however, flour mill production was slightly reduced to about 5-1/2 days, a Buffalo dealer said. But the market was thin, he added.
Elsewhere activity was subdued. "There are no trades. It is very quiet," a Carolinas dealer said, adding there was very little fill-in business.
